ayahs.2: And the night when it grows still—
ayahs.3: Your Rabb—the One who creates, owns, nurtures, and sustains—has not forsaken you, O Prophet, nor does He despise you; a pause in revelation did not mean abandonment.
ayahs.4: The Akhirah—the everlasting life after death—is better for you than this dunya, the temporary worldly life.
ayahs.5: And your Rabb will give you until you are pleased—
ayahs.6: Did He not find you an orphan and give shelter?
ayahs.7: Did He not find you seeking and guide you?
ayahs.8: Did He not find you in need and enrich you?
ayahs.9: So do not oppress the orphan—
ayahs.10: And do not drive away the beggar—
ayahs.11: And proclaim the blessings of your Rabb—speak of His favours with shukr, gratitude shown in word and deed.
